core-basics.objective: Explain what a commit is and why the commit graph looks the way it does.
Use git init, git add, git status, git log and git diff confidently.
Create and switch branches and understand what HEAD means.
Merge one branch into another and understand fast-forward vs. a merge commit.
Clone a remote, and push, pull and fetch to and from it.
Write a .gitignore and explain what it does.
Set your identity with git config (user.name / user.email) and explain why commits record an author.
